presets.name: Recommended
presets.description: Atmosphère + Hekate + safe configs + a few essential apps. Good for most people.

presets.name: Minimal
presets.description: Only what is needed to boot custom firmware.

packages.name: Atmosphère
packages.description: The custom firmware itself. Includes the Homebrew Menu (hbmenu) and Homebrew Loader.

packages.name: Hekate & Nyx
packages.description: Bootloader used to launch Atmosphère, create emuMMC, make NAND backups and more. Its payload is placed at bootloader/update.bin and atmosphere/reboot_payload.bin.

packages.name: Recommended configs
packages.description: hekate_ipl.ini boot menu (emuMMC / sysMMC / Stock), DNS-MITM host files that block Nintendo servers, and exosphere.ini that blanks your console's serial on emuMMC. Strongly recommended to reduce ban risk.

files.content:
[config]
autoboot=0
autoboot_list=0
bootwait=3
backlight=100
noticker=0
autohosoff=1
autonogc=1
updater2p=1
bootprotect=0

[CFW (emuMMC)]
emummcforce=1
fss0=atmosphere/package3
icon=bootloader/res/icon_payload.bmp

[CFW (sysMMC)]
emummc_force_disable=1
fss0=atmosphere/package3
icon=bootloader/res/icon_payload.bmp

[Stock (sysMMC)]
emummc_force_disable=1
fss0=atmosphere/package3
stock=1
icon=bootloader/res/icon_switch.bmp

[exosphere]
debugmode=1
debugmode_user=0
disable_user_exception_handlers=0
enable_user_pmu_access=0
blank_prodinfo_sysmmc=0
blank_prodinfo_emummc=1
allow_writing_to_cal_sysmmc=0
log_port=0
log_baud_rate=115200
log_inverted=0

packages.name: JKSV
packages.description: Save data manager: back up and restore your game saves.

packages.name: Homebrew App Store
packages.description: Browse and install homebrew apps directly on the console.

packages.name: ftpd
packages.description: FTP server: transfer files to the SD card over Wi-Fi without removing it.

packages.name: NX-Shell
packages.description: File manager for the SD card.

packages.name: Goldleaf
packages.description: Multipurpose tool: file browser, ticket and title management, USB transfers with Quark.

packages.name: TegraExplorer
packages.description: Payload-based file explorer and NAND tool. Launch it from Hekate → Payloads.
